---
title: "Can we reconstruct the FT Mighty Mini Explorer within tolerance?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 240.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 7.8      # s the probe actually used

targets = evaluate_targets(airplane, dry_mass_props, total_mass_props)
worst_target = max(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t["err_pct"]))
worst_err = abs(worst_target["err_pct"])

span_tgt = next(t for t in targets if t["name"] == "Wing span")
span_mm = span_tgt["measured"] * 1e3
span_tgt_mm = span_tgt["target"] * 1e3

len_tgt = next(t for t in targets if t["name"] == "Length")
len_mm = len_tgt["measured"] * 1e3
len_tgt_mm = len_tgt["target"] * 1e3

dry_tgt = next(t for t in targets if t["name"] == "Dry weight")
dry_g = dry_tgt["measured"] * 1e3
dry_tgt_g = dry_tgt["target"] * 1e3

cg_tgt = next(t for t in targets if t["name"] == "CG aft LE")
cg_mm = cg_tgt["measured"] * 1e3
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{worst_err:.2f}%"`]{.hero-value}
[worst reconstruction error across published targets]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Yes. All published targets are reproduced within tolerance, with a maximum error of [`{python} f"{worst_err:.2f}%"`]{.key} on dry weight (@fig-target-errors). Wing span derives to [`{python} f"{span_mm:.1f}"`]{.key} mm against a [`{python} f"{span_tgt_mm:.1f}"`]{.key} mm target, and length falls out at [`{python} f"{len_mm:.1f}"`]{.key} mm against [`{python} f"{len_tgt_mm:.1f}"`]{.key} mm. Dry airframe mass totals [`{python} f"{dry_g:.1f}"`]{.key} g against the [`{python} f"{dry_tgt_g:.0f}"`]{.key} g target. Positioning the flight battery in the nose balances the aircraft at [`{python} f"{cg_mm:.1f}"`]{.key} mm aft of the leading edge (@fig-three-view). The airframe shape is unverified against photographic plans.

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **Fuselage stations**: slab box with 195 mm nose.
2. **Wing planform**: 190 mm chord and polyhedral tips.
3. **Wing airfoil**: Clark-Y for folded foam camber.
4. **Tail surfaces**: flat plate horizontal and vertical stabilizers.
5. **Component masses**: catalogue electronics plus 38 g glue.
6. **Wing area**: [`{python} f"{airplane.s_ref:.3f}"`]{.key} m^2 derived from planform.
:::
